wallpapers.title: BLOOMING FLOWER
wallpapers.line1: An eight-fold flower whose petals breathe and change shape while the whole flower slowly turns.
wallpapers.line2: A Julia set (z -> z^2 + c) folded into eight mirrored wedges; c walks a small circle, so every petal reshapes and comes back.

wallpapers.title: FLOWER TUNNEL
wallpapers.line1: Falling forever down a spiral tunnel lined with fractal flowers, toward a glowing light.
wallpapers.line2: The same Julia flower tiled along a log-polar spiral; one loop falls two rings deeper, which looks exactly like the start.

wallpapers.title: SWIRL
wallpapers.line1: A six-armed fractal swirl, its glowing petals turning and melting into new shapes.
wallpapers.line2: A Julia set near c = 0.285 + 0.01i, folded six ways and twisted along a log spiral.

wallpapers.title: HEPTAGON SKY
wallpapers.line1: Endless triangles of seven around a point, shrinking toward the rim, turning while the colours flow through them.
wallpapers.line2: The {7,3} tiling of the hyperbolic plane in the Poincare disk: every tile is the same size in that geometry.

wallpapers.title: LIQUID MANDALA
wallpapers.line1: A ten-fold kaleidoscope of flowing marbled colour that never quite repeats inside the loop.
wallpapers.line2: Warped value noise (fractional Brownian motion fed through itself twice), mirrored ten ways.

wallpapers.title: ENDLESS BAND
wallpapers.line1: A ribbon of tiles stretching off both sides of the screen, four meeting at every corner, five around every centre.
wallpapers.line2: The {5,4} hyperbolic tiling in the band model, the whole plane laid along one straight strip.
